service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events in the Colorado mountain corridor, solo through quartet, with travel and lodging itemised as their own lines.

faqs.q: What does live music cost at a mountain resort?
faqs.a: A resort date costs more than a metro date for two reasons, both named on the quote as their own lines. Travel, because Vail and Beaver Creek are a mountain highway from Denver and Aspen is most of a working day each way. And a night's lodging past the passes, because a band that finishes late in Aspen isn't driving back over the passes that night. Both are on the quote before you sign.

faqs.q: What does the resort need to provide?
faqs.a: One or two dedicated 20-amp circuits within reach of the performance area, a load-in window of 45 to 90 minutes depending on size, and the cap and curfew figures at contract. Dedicated means not shared with catering warmers, which is the most common cause of a load-in problem.

faqs.q: Do you honour decibel caps and curfews?
faqs.a: Yes, as written. Mountain venues run on their own rules, so tell us the cap and the curfew when you book and both go into the plan, with the set built to land on the curfew.

faqs.q: Can the band play outdoors at altitude?
faqs.a: Yes, on a covered, level and dry performance area with power run to it and a move-indoors call time written before the day. Mountain evenings drop fast, and instruments and electronics both stop behaving in the cold. Altitude also changes pacing: singers and horn players tire faster in thin air, so the night is paced for it.
No. Lodging applies on far-resort dates, Aspen among them, and is billed at cost as its own line on the quote. A far-resort date is a two-day trip for the band.

faqs.q: Do you play company offsites for remote and hybrid teams?
faqs.a: Yes, and the offsite is now the most common reason a company books a mountain evening. The bookings that fit it are the arrival-night duo at conversation volume, the Colorado evening with the Americana band, live band karaoke as the night the team remembers, and the last-night dance floor with a band or the DJ, on one contract for the whole stay. Tell us the dates, the venue and roughly how many are flying in.
